info.title: OpenAsy Files API
info.summary: The company's files in team and project spaces on OpenCloud, with expiring links.
info.description:
Every screen of Files uses this API, and so can your scripts (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

Spaces, their groups and the rules for links and the recycle bin are set in files.yaml, never through the API; Files keeps OpenCloud in step with it. A person's own files and links take the session of that person, never an API token, and go to OpenCloud as that person. Everything else takes a session or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: user, viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003).

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

post.description: On the day, a space named after the person is made with their manager as its manager, their own files are copied into it, and their OpenCloud account is disabled. Their own space is kept as it is. Needs the admin role.

post.description: Makes and updates spaces, their groups and quotas, disables spaces that left the file, shortens links that last too long and empties recycle bins after bin.keepDays. This also happens after each change of the file and every five minutes. Needs the admin role.

200.description: Spaces, storage, links, the file and the last sync.

Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when Files runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the Files origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_files_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when Files is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

error.description: Why the file on disk is not applied; the last good version stays until it is fixed.

text.description: The text of the version that is applied.

ConfigFile.description: files.yaml and whether it is applied; null before it was first read.

purged.description: Items removed from recycle bins after bin.keepDays.

stored.description: Bytes over every space, at the last sync.

openCloudUrl.description: Where people open OpenCloud and point its desktop and phone apps.

on.description: The day; today when left out.

driveId.description: The space the files went to.

error.description: Why the last try failed; it is tried again at the next sync.

for.description: Whom the link is for, as its maker named it.

opens.description: Openings with the right password, from OpenCloud's audit log.

problem.description: What the rules found that Files could not fix.

shared.description: In at least one link to someone outside.

name.description: The item's name, shown on the Links page until the next sync.

kind.description: upload: people outside may only add files to the folder.

expires.description: The last day; links.maxDays from today when left out.
